entities.summary: Tchort (b. 1974-07-07, Kristiansand) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kristiansand and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
